program: Wingless cross-manifest replication of frozen training-only marginal-rank signal
question: Does the R18-calibrated training-only state-change score rank productive marginal adaptation intervals on the original external manifest, without refitting weights or using evaluation labels in the signal?
hypothesis: Freeze the score entirely from sealed R18 evidence using the preregistered bounded grid w_baseline,w_churn,w_best in {0..5}: maximize positive-vs-zero interval AUC on R18; tie-break minimum L1 weight then lexicographic weights. This yields weights (1,3,0) and calibration AUC 0.90. On the original immutable manifest only, replay the R15 budget grids, 15,819 non-target bytes, 256 motifs, 582-byte sealed evaluation, and 872-byte adaptation reservoir. For each adjacent interval compute rank_signal=(baseline_argmax_change_count + 3*(motif_entry_count+motif_exit_count))/bytes_added using training/adaptation state only. After freezing all signals, open evaluation outcomes and measure positive-vs-zero AUC plus pairwise concordance against exact-hit gain per byte. No R19 label may refit weights or alter the score.

calibration_rule.objective: positive-vs-zero interval AUC on sealed R18 only
calibration_rule.tie_break: minimum L1 weight, then lexicographic weights

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

classification_rules.supported: valid and positive_vs_zero_auc >= 0.75 and marginal_efficiency_pairwise_concordance >= 0.65 and mean_positive_rank_signal > mean_zero_rank_signal
classification_rules.mixed: valid and positive_vs_zero_auc >= 0.60 with mean_positive_rank_signal > mean_zero_rank_signal, but supported thresholds are not all met
classification_rules.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, source, split, budget-grid, frozen-weight identity, signal-label isolation, capacity, deterministic replay, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter source identities, 15,819-byte non-target budget, 256 capacity, 582/872 split, budget grids, weights (1,3,0), normalization, evaluator, 0.75/0.65/0.60 thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: freeze an allocation rule from the cross-manifest calibrated rank signal and validate it only on a newly admitted disjoint future manifest under the same total budget

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: factor false-positive and rank-error intervals across the two manifests before another allocation policy
